source_head: see manifest.json commit for the exact revision of this run
notes: verified means covered by a Spec 20P0 AP test with a real SDK against a local HTTP/SSE fixture, not merely present in source
all routes go through the single send point app/execution_plane/models/client.py::SDKModelClient._send
callback granularity is per litellm SDK call; the server received exactly one HTTP request per callback in AP03
internal hooks referenced below are private and version-sensitive; no monkeypatching of the SDK is used as a production mechanism

sdk_call.reason_num_retries_zero: single retry owner: Harness (QueryLoop) or SDKModelClient bounded budget, never both

callback_surface.otel_granularity: one span per litellm SDK call (request level), verified by AP13
callback_surface.parent_span_flag: USE_OTEL_LITELLM_REQUEST_SPAN=true is declared once at bootstrap; without it LiteLLM 1.98 writes usage/cost to the parent span and creates no model span
callback_surface.span_enrichment: backend/app/infrastructure/observability/litellm_span_enricher.py adds openinference.span.kind=LLM and codesage.provider_request_id at span start (OTel rejects attribute writes after span end)
callback_surface.llm_kind_owner: only the SDK integration declares LLM-kind spans; the Harness attempt container (provider.request) is CHAIN
callback_surface.test_timing_note: under pytest the SDK success callback can land after a test's force_flush window when a parent span is active; the production loop keeps running, so this is a harness artifact, not a missing span
callback_surface.deployment_attempt_granularity: not exposed by the integration; per-attempt distinction relies on the single call site plus num_retries=0
callback_surface.underlying_http_retry_granularity: not observable through public hooks; disabled via num_retries=0 and verified by AP04 HTTP counts
callback_surface.content_capture: OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT=NO_CONTENT when capture_content=false; litellm.turn_off_message_logging is set once at bootstrap

usage_sources: OpenAI-compatible usage object; provider extensions when present
Not exercised in this round: no fixture route asserted for the gemini transport

routes.notes: LiteLLM has no Baidu protocol transport; the self-built adapter was removed, so configuration fails before sending

known_gaps.summary: LiteLLM 1.98 deepseek/ streaming path parses raw HTTP chunk framing as SSE lines and raises 'int' object has no attribute 'get'
known_gaps.impact: vendor prefixes are not used for OpenAI-compatible providers; the openai/ prefix is used instead

known_gaps.summary: LiteLLM 1.98 delivers the merged usage chunk after the finish chunk
known_gaps.impact: the client keeps reading for a bounded tail window (TAIL_METADATA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)

known_gaps.summary: When the gateway closes the connection gracefully after a truncated stream, the SDK reports a normal end of stream
known_gaps.impact: truncation is detected only when no terminal finish_reason is observed; explicit Connection: close truncation degrades to done plus dropped_incomplete_tool_calls

known_gaps.summary: Some success callbacks can be dropped by LiteLLM under concurrent dispatch
known_gaps.impact: request/config/auth isolation is unaffected; sequential calls record their callback
